# LEGION phone screen map

How to reach every LEGION phone screen from launch, for an agent driving the real phone with
`python tools/phone` (skill: `.claude/skills/verify-on-phone/`). `python tools/phone open <id>`
does the walking: a nav route opens by deep link (`am start ... --es route <route>`, the same
`EXTRA_ROUTE` a notification uses); anything else by linking to the nearest screen on its path that
has a deep link and tapping the rest. `open <id> --by-taps` walks every tap from HOME instead,
which is how a hands path (ADR 0035) gets checked.

Selectors are the app's own fixed strings, never coordinates. **Test tags need a build with
`testTagsAsResourceId` (phone-verify ticket 04); on an older build use the text and desc
selectors.** Generated by `tools/screen_map.py` from `ui/LegionRoute.kt`, `ui/MainActivity.kt`,
the manifest, `MatrixDest` and `tools/screen_map_copy.py`; a new route with no entry fails the
script and the commit hook.

44 nav routes, 4 activities, 10 Matrix screens, 1 in-screen drilldowns.

  - tag `memory-`: one memory row (`memory-<id>`)

  - tag `forget-`: Forget (`forget-<id>`): a hard delete - refused without Kevin's yes

## Activities

<a id="s-browser"></a>
### Browser

LEGION's own browser (ADR 0071).

- **Id:** `browser`
- **Open:** `python tools/phone open browser` (taps from HOME; no deep link of its own)
- **Needs:** Matrix mode for the tap path; voice opens it anywhere
- **From launch:** Matrix HOME > text `Browser`
- **Voice tools that open it:** `browser`

<a id="s-claude-page"></a>
### Claude page

A page a Claude session task delivered to the phone (signed, sandboxed). Opened from a task on the Claude session screen.

- **Id:** `claude-page`
- **Open:** `python tools/phone open claude-page` (deep link `route=claude-session`, then taps; no deep link of its own)
- **Needs:** a delivered page; no fixed selector reaches one
- **From launch:** no fixed tap path (a delivered page; no fixed selector reaches one); see Needs
- **Voice tools that open it:** `claude_session`

<a id="s-reader"></a>
### Book reader

EPUB reader (ADR 0061). Opened from a book tile on HOME's Books sheet or by voice.

- **Id:** `reader`
- **Open:** `python tools/phone open reader` (deep link `route=home`, then taps; no deep link of its own)
- **Needs:** a book on the phone; this reach stops at the Books sheet
- **From launch:** HOME > text `Books`
- **Voice tools that open it:** `books`

<a id="s-vault"></a>
### ID vault

Passport, NRIC, SSN, A-number, account numbers (ADR 0076). Its own window with FLAG_SECURE, so a screenshot of it is blank by design. The list shows labels only; a value shows only after Show and the fingerprint. **`tools/phone` refuses every tap in it except Back, and refuses typing.** Checking the list and that a screenshot blanks is the whole of what an agent may do here.

- **Id:** `vault`
- **Code:** `ui/vault/VaultScreen.kt`
- **Open:** `python tools/phone open vault` (deep link `route=settings/data-privacy`, then taps; no deep link of its own)
- **On screen when open:** text `ID vault`
- **From launch:** HOME > desc `Settings` > text `LEGION settings` > text `Data and privacy` > text `ID vault`
- **Test tags:** `vault-<id>`, `vault-copy`, `vault-message`, `vault-show`
- **Key controls:**
  - tag `vault-message`: the status line
  - tag `vault-`: one item's card (`vault-<id>`), label only
  - text `Show`: fingerprint, then the value - REFUSED, no override
  - text `Copy`: copies the value - REFUSED, no override
  - text `Add an item`: REFUSED in the vault
- **Voice tools that open it:** `show_vault_item`

## Selector kinds

- **text** - exact visible text, case and spacing ignored. Compose merges a row's children into the
  clickable row, so the row's label is usually on the clickable node itself.
- **desc** - content description: icon buttons (`Settings`, `Back`, `Apps`) and the chat field.
  A value ending `...` in the tables above is a prefix (`Chat with ...` carries the companion's name).
- **tag** - `Modifier.testTag`, visible to uiautomator as `resource-id` only on a build with
  `testTagsAsResourceId` at the window root. Tags inside a dialog are not exposed (a dialog is its own
  window); use the dialog's text.
- **Matrix mode** changes HOME: the Soft home's tiles, gear and chat button are not there. `open`
  checks which home is up before it taps, and never turns Matrix mode on or off itself.
